name: Midnight Skyline
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Code City visual design proposal, preview only, before implementation.
Create one extremely polished, legible product design presentation board, landscape 4:3, ideally 2048x1536. This is a technical open-source visualization product turning source code repositories into deterministic isometric cities. Render a designed flat screenshot/artboard, not a photographed screen, no device frame.
BOARD STRUCTURE: dark outer canvas. Small top title with proposal letter and name. Two clearly separated deliverables: upper section is a prominent GitHub README banner at exactly 1200:420 aspect ratio (about 88% of board width); lower section is a compact wide desktop app preview using the SAME recognizable city geometry and color coding. Keep the upper banner the visual hero. Professionally align everything, use generous margins and clearly readable sparse text.
HARD REQUIREMENTS: 2.5D orthographic isometric view, all building edges parallel along the isometric axes; low polygon simple flat-faced buildings that can later be recreated using native SVG polygons, light simple shadows, subtle lit window rectangles; no photographic textures, no giant bloom, no external image textures. Dark GitHub-like background #0d1117. Restrained low-saturation cyan/blue for TypeScript, amber for JavaScript, violet for Python, green roofs for tests. Approximately 30 buildings split among 4 clearly recognizable repository districts, only 2 or 3 landmark buildings. Files map to buildings, height suggests code lines; district area suggests repository size. Docs are a low library with a small plaza, tests have green roofs and small parks. Roads and whitespace visibly separate districts.
CONTENT: brand "CODE CITY"; banner title "My Code City"; subtitle "A skyline built from code"; small stats "4 repositories" "30 files" "12.8k lines". Sample repo district labels "atlas", "orbit", "tools", "docs". Language legend "TypeScript", "JavaScript", "Python". All values are fictional fixture data, not claims about real repos.
APP PREVIEW: slim nav "CODE CITY" on left and "Overview" / "Repositories" / "Export SVG"; large central city; discreet top filters "All repositories" and "Height: lines"; contextual small file inspector showing "src/main.ts", "TypeScript", "248 lines", "4.2 KB"; tiny orbit/zoom/reset controls. It is an actual visualization interface, not a marketing landing page. No pricing, login, giant marketing CTA, generic chart grid, stock photos, decorative code wallpaper, or random cyberpunk props. Main app view is a forward-looking visual concept. Banner is the first implementation target.
All important text must be accurately spelled, small quantity, realistic system sans-serif UI with monospaced file paths. No nonsense text. No fabricated verified data or real account names. Do not render descriptive prompt language on the board.
VARIANT A — "A / MIDNIGHT SKYLINE"
VISUAL DIRECTION: Sophisticated, calm developer tool, the closest interpretation of the brief. City is one compact continuous urban ground plane with clearly visible roads dividing four neighborhoods. Broad horizontal skyline, moderate central tower, grouped building silhouettes, plenty of dark breathing room. Cyan and slate blue dominate; muted violet and warm amber are supporting accents. City sits on a very thin dark base slab. Restrained fine luminous windows, extremely subtle shadows, crisp clean SVG-like geometry. README banner title block occupies left 24%, city occupies right 72%, language legend along bottom. Excellent silhouette at thumbnail size. Interface below has almost no heavy panels, a narrow left repo list, city across the middle, a small inspector anchored lower right. Overall precise, quiet, premium, practical to implement. Make the city feel substantial and delightful without excessive density.

VARIANT B — "B / REPOSITORY ISLANDS"
VISUAL DIRECTION: Memorable spatial organization. Four separate isometric polygonal land platforms suspended over the same flat near-black background, staggered horizontally with clear dark gaps. A few narrow simple walkways connect neighboring platforms. Each island has a distinct language accent, still restrained: cyan, muted lilac, muted amber, and sage. Small flat plaza/library on docs island; test park/green roofs. Tallest island at center-right; silhouette balanced, not overly tall. Repo names on tiny well-aligned floating labels close to their island bases. Banner title in top left with generous space, city dominates center and right, lower edge holds understated stats and legend. Desktop preview is a spacious full-width city canvas with compact horizontal repo selector pills along top, selection gives one island a thin cyan outline and small inspector at right. SVG-reproducible geometric facets, no volumetric atmosphere. Prioritize district recognizability and visual charm.
